name: AI Voice (Text to Speech)
description: Text-to-speech APIs compared on the same 30 prompts: transcript accuracy, naturalness, instruction following, and speed.

metrics.label: Transcript accuracy
metrics.description: The audio is transcribed by an independent speech-recognition model and compared word-for-word with the prompt. 10 = zero word errors.

metrics.label: Naturalness
metrics.description: Predicted mean opinion score from a reference-free speech quality model (UTMOS / NISQA), rescaled to 1-10.

metrics.label: Instruction following
metrics.description: An LLM jury checks the transcript and audio metadata against the prompt's explicit constraints: language, pauses, digit-by-digit numbers, pronunciation notes, tone.

metrics.label: Speed
metrics.description: Time to first audio byte and total generation time, ranked against every other run in the category. 10 = fastest decile.
